headline: For fighting, rallies and internet posts: Russia tightens rules for migrants
summary: Russia has more than doubled the list of administrative offences for which foreign citizens can be deported, including fights, rallies and certain online posts. The new rules were reported by a regional outlet.
why: Migrant workers fill labour shortages in Russia's construction and services sectors, so tighter enforcement affects labour supply and employers.
original_headline: За драку, митинг и пост в интернете. В России ужесточили правила для мигрантов
